verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents creating and exporting issues to GitHub, GitLab and Jira (Cloud and Server) from errors, so the linking half of the story is first-party. Nothing shows status syncing back from the tracker: there is no evidence that closing a ticket resolves the error or that a regression reopens the linked ticket. missing for 10: two-way status sync (ticket closed → error resolved), regression reopening the linked ticket, Linear integration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it

citations.quote: your issue exports to GitHub or GitLab will contain the full markdown, or the full Jira wiki for JIRA Cloud and JIRA Server
You get to choose which error events result in a notification or ticket being created
